The '''Corellian Sector ''' was a high-rise district located on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. Casinos and trendy hotspots such as the [[Meltdown Café]] attracted patrons from all walks of life.<ref name="A Hunter's Fate: Greedo's Tale">{{StoryCite|story=A Hunter's Fate: Greedo's Tale|book=Tales from the Mos Eisley Cantina}}</ref>

The Sector could be reached by a secret tunnel entrance from the [[Duros Sector]].<ref name="Dark Empire II">''[[Star Wars: Dark Empire II]]''</ref>

==Culture==
Though dominated politically and economically by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] and [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]]-descended [[Human/Legends|Humans]], people of many [[Species/Legends|species]] lived in the Corellian Sector. One of the more populated habitats within the Corellian Sector was the public housing area and the machine shops atop [[Level 88]]. [[Outlaw tech/Legends|Outlaw tech]] [[Shug Ninx]] and his assistant [[Warb]] maintained their own repair workshop in this area and bartered for everything from power couplings for [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300]] [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighters]] to heavy-duty hull plating for [[Starjammer-IZX fast freight hauler]]s.<ref name="A Hunter's Fate: Greedo's Tale" />

Crime was abundant in the Corellian Sector, but the authorities at [[Corellian Port Control]] largely ignored the smaller offenses and partially encouraged the occasional bounty killing.<ref name="A Hunter's Fate: Greedo's Tale" /> Professional hunters such as [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] and [[Dengar/Legends|Dengar]] were able to find easy work tracking down wanted criminals throughout the various city-levels.<ref name="Dark Empire">''[[Star Wars: Dark Empire]]''</ref>

[[Smuggler/Legends|Smuggler]] and future hero of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] lived for many years in the grease spattered streets of the Corellian Sector.<ref name="The Hutt Gambit">''[[The Hutt Gambit]]''</ref> The [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Greedo/Legends|Greedo]] and his family, members of the [[Tetsu Clan]] who had fled [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia's]] clan wars, also lived in Level 88.<ref name="A Hunter's Fate: Greedo's Tale" />

==History==
===Old Republic Era===
[[File:Chemical_Refinement_District.png|thumb|left|250px|The Chemical Refinement District in the lower levels of the sector. The Exchange ran their spice refinement operation here.]]
During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], the sector was controlled by several criminal organizations including the [[Krayts]], the [[Shadow Syndicate/Legends|Shadow Syndicate]], and the [[Exchange]], which dominated the sector and ran a massive [[Spice/Legends|spice]]-refinement operation out of the lower levels. This expansion prompted a hostile response from the Shadow Syndicate, leading to increased violence and ultimately the death of [[Ukabi]], the Exchange's boss on Nar Shaddaa

Both the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] and [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] operated listening posts in the district. The district was the location of much pro-[[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] sentiment during the war as many Republic veterans retired there.

===Rebellion Era===
In [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], this region became the focus of a [[Battle of Nar Shaddaa (Galactic Civil War)|major clash]] between the soldiers of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the freedom fighters of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. The Rebels had managed to insert covert [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Rebel SpecForce]] operatives into the ranks of Corellian Port Control. Through these agents, they were able to smuggle high-end munitions out of the district inside of sealed packing crates. In the dead of night, [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] would fly the weapons off-world in the cargo bays of huge [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvettes]].<ref name="A Hunter's Fate: Greedo's Tale" />

[[File:Nar_Shaddaa_Corellian_Sector_LoNH.png|thumb|right|200px|A Corellian woman conducting business with a Toydarian in the area]]
Two [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]], [[Spurch Goa]] and [[Dyyz Nataz]], learned of these operations from Greedo and sold the information to the Empire. As a result, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] sent two camouflaged [[Gamma-class assault shuttle/Legends|''Gamma''-class Assault Shuttles]] to the Corellian Sector to raze the district. SpecForce operative [[Spane Covis]] recognized the disguised freighters and alerted the Rebel commandos. Imperial [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] disembarked from the shuttles and engaged in a firefight with twenty Rebel soldiers. The Rebels managed to fight off the Imperials with a [[C4-CZN ion field gun]]. Despite the temporary victory, a large portion of the Corellian Sector was destroyed when a second wave of Imperials arrived. An entire quarter collapsed, taking out some twenty levels. Level 88, home to Greedo's family, was one of the areas devastated in the attack, though Greedo himself escaped to the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] with Goa and Nataz.<ref name="A Hunter's Fate: Greedo's Tale" />

===New Republic Era===
[[File:Corellian_Sector_Invincible.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The ''Invincible'' above the Corellian Sector.]]
In [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]], Han Solo and his wife [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] visited the Corellian Sector on a mission to contact his old smuggling associates and gain access to the Imperial fortress world of Byss. During this visit, Organa Solo met the aged [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Vima-Da-Boda]], who gave her a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. After the Solos, [[Salla Zend]], and Shug Ninx escaped from the bounty hunters Boba Fett and Dengar.<ref name="Dark Empire" /> Afterward, the Solos and their associates returned to the Corellian Sector to meet with Vima-Da-Boda again. As they left with her, they escaped a group of bounty hunters (including a group of [[Gank/Legends|Gank]] killers and, once again, Boba Fett), and destroyed the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] commanded by [[Zasm Katth]] and [[Baddon Fass]] by crashing it into the moon's surface.<ref name="Dark Empire II" />
